replies.text: Thanks for the kind words! Visiting one is definitely worth it. The easiest is Agrasen Ki Baoli in New Delhi—just a short walk from Connaught Place, and entry is free. For the most spectacular, Chand Baori in Abhaneri, Rajasthan, is the deepest and most photographed, about 95 km from Jaipur. And if you want a UNESCO-listed masterpiece, Rani Ki Vav in Patan, Gujarat, is incredibly carved. Which kind of experience are you looking for—an easy city stop or a full day trip?
